title: A notice holding newlines aborts coax when it is cut to fit the screen
body: The Claude adapter reports a hit usage limit as an error whose text holds JSON on several lines, and coax shows it as a notice. `cut` in `ui.rs` counted a newline as no column while trimming, though `str::width` counts it as one. The trimmed notice measured wider than the screen, and `(width - text.width()) / 2` in `build_transcript` wrapped around. The release build then aborted in `str::repeat`. Seen in a core dump on 2026-11-24, on a screen between about 97 and 124 columns wide.
